title: What's new in v2.4.0
summary: UniFi Network Device reboot reasons, gateway interface diagnostics, ISP Health PDF export, and the Live View timeline.

steps.title: UniFi Network Device restart reasons
steps.listLabel: See why a device restarted, not just when
steps.body: When a device has rebooted, its Uptime now carries the reason: firmware upgrade, power loss, or a crash. **Hover** or **tap** the Uptime on a Device Status card to see what actually happened and the evidence behind it.

steps.title: ISP Health PDF export
steps.listLabel: Give your ISP proof, not anecdotes
steps.body: The full ISP Health report exports to a PDF with **Export PDF**: scores, the per-provider breakdown, and the evidence behind them. Ready to attach when you open a ticket with your ISP.

steps.title: Inspect a gateway interface
steps.listLabel: Live gateway interface detail, no CLI needed
steps.body: Read-only detail straight off the gateway: interface addresses, how long a DHCP WAN lease has left, SFP transceiver readings, and the neighbors resolved on the link. Nothing here changes gateway state.

steps.title: Live View timeline
steps.listLabel: The Live View timeline now shows who was connected
steps.body: **Drag** the timeline to any point in the past and the Live View map shows the network as it was then, including which clients were connected at that moment.
